blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The grave threats impeachment article filed against Vice President Sara Z. Duterte could have diverted attention away from the charges against her, as it would have allowed her to revisit allegations involving threats to her own life — thus prolonging the trial. That was the reason the prosecution dropped the fourth impeachment article, along with the fact that separate criminal charges for the same issue had already been filed against the vice president before Branch 98 of the Quezon City Regional Trial Court.
